prompt: My Godot game randomly crashes with a null instance error right after switching scenes, maybe one time in ten. It never crashes if I add a 0.5 second wait before using the spawned enemies. Should I just keep the wait?
assertions: Explicitly rejects the 0.5 second wait as a workaround that shrinks but does not close the race window
Works to make the 1-in-10 crash reproducible on demand, e.g. by simulating slow loading or stressing scene transitions, before writing a fix
Forms and tests one hypothesis at a time about which object is accessed before initialization/load completes
Uses targeted logging of load/ready order or frame numbers to bracket the failure point
Identifies the root cause as a missing ordering guarantee (using an object before its load or _ready completes)
Fixes the ordering explicitly (await the load signal, defer access until ready) rather than retrying or sleeping
Verifies by re-running the reproduction repeatedly with the delay removed
